title: The Night Leo Met Bedroom Shadows: Night Bravery!

lines.text: The bedroom lights clicked off, and Leo pulled the cozy blankets up to his chin!
lines.caps: The bedroom lights clicked *OFF, | and Leo pulled the cozy blankets up *TO | his *CHIN!

lines.text: Creak! A giant spiky silhouette stretched across his bedroom closet door!
lines.caps: *CREAK! A giant spiky silhouette *STRETCHED | across his bedroom closet *DOOR!

lines.text: Is that a secret clawed monster lurking in the shadows? Leo's heart beat fast!
lines.caps: Is that a secret clawed monster *LURKING | in the shadows? Leo's heart *BEAT | *FAST!

lines.text: He reached out his trembling hand and clicked on his little superhero flashlight!
lines.caps: He reached out his trembling *HAND | and clicked on his little superhero *FLASHLIGHT!

lines.text: Click! Warm golden light filled the corner, showing his winter jacket and baseball cap!
lines.caps: *CLICK! Warm golden light filled the *CORNER, | showing his winter jacket and *BASEBALL | *CAP!

lines.text: The coat rack had cast a funny shadow because the nightlight was low on the floor!
lines.caps: The coat rack had cast a funny *SHADOW | because the nightlight was low on the *FLOOR!

lines.text: Shadows look spooky because your imagination tries to fill in the dark spaces!
lines.caps: Shadows look spooky because your *IMAGINATION | tries to fill in the dark *SPACES!

lines.text: Whenever you feel scared of shadows, just shine your light and meet the silly truth!
lines.caps: Whenever you feel scared of *SHADOWS, | just shine your light and meet the silly *TRUTH!

lines.text: Be brave at bedtime and subscribe to BabyBeats Rhymo!
